title: Creetion carries the directory's deepest Flowable commitment: one of only three platforms
content:
Creetion focuses on three platforms — SAP, OutSystems and Flowable — and that narrowness is the finding: it is the deepest Flowable commitment recorded anywhere in the directory sweep. Most firms in the same cohort list Flowable among a dozen or more alliances, where a single platform is a line item rather than a bet.

Depth of commitment is a better predictor of carrier behaviour than certification tier. A firm with three platforms has staked its positioning on them, so the Flowable practice has real consultants attached and a pipeline that depends on process orchestration selling well. That is precisely the seam the record-layer argument attaches to, and it makes Creetion a partner with something to gain from strengthening the Flowable story rather than a partner with one more logo to place.

The complication in the same record is OutSystems, one of the other two platforms — an app-layer position of the kind the screen treats as slot occupancy elsewhere. So the Flowable strength and a potential conflict sit in the same three-platform list, which is worth resolving before a pitch. The row is ranked priority 2 and its provenance is the Flowable Partner Finder mined on 2026-08-18; it has not been imprint-swept, so contact and legal details are still unverified.
